As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 120, "Wheels and Rims-Other than Passenger Cars."

items.title: Waymo LLC: Software May Allow Vehicle to Enter and Drive In Freeway Construction Zones

items.title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Insufficient Interior Joint Strength/FMVSS 221

Front and mid-body interior joints may have been manufactured incorrectly, resulting in insufficient joint strength. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 221, "School Bus Body Joint Strength."

items.title: Piaggio Group Americas, Inc.: Missing Warning on Rearview Mirrors
items.summary: Piaggio Group Americas, Inc. (PGA) is recalling certain 2026 Vespa GTV 310, Vespa Primavera 150, and Vespa Primavera 50 motorcycles in the color Officina 8. The convex mirror warning "objects in mirror are closer than they appear," is missing.

items.title: Ford Motor Company: Vehicle Rollaway Risk/FMVSS 114
items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2026 Escape and Lincoln Corsair vehicles. The integrated park module may fail to lock into the park position when the driver shifts into park. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 114, "Theft Protection and Rollaway Prevention."

items.title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: DOT Code Mark Missing from Driver's Door Window/FMVSS 205
items.summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2019-2020 LFS Artic and 2019-2023 LFS transit buses. The driver's speaker hole door may have been built with the prime glazing manufacturer DOT code mark missing. As such, these vehicles fail to conform to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 205, "Glazing Materials."

items.title: Ford Motor Company: Hard Top May Crack and Detach
items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Bronco vehicles. The 3-door and 5-door Molded-In-Color (MIC) hardtop roof panels may have been manufactured improperly, which can allow sections of the outer roof panel to separate and detach from the vehicle.

items.title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Seat Belt Warning System Malfunction/FMVSS 208
items.summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2026 Land Rover Range Rover Velar, Range Rover Sport, and Range Rover vehicles. The seat belt warning system may not activate the audible warning chime as intended. As such, these vehicles fail to conform with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

items.title: Tenneco Automotive: Improperly Tightened Lower Ball Joint Nut
items.summary: Federal-Mogul Motorparts LLC (DRiV) is recalling certain Beck/Arnley replacement lower control arm and ball joint assemblies for 2018-2025 Subaru Forester and Crosstrek vehicles. The lower ball joint nut may be loose or may not have been tightened properly.

items.title: Braun Corporation: Wheelchair Restraint Retractor May Not Lock
items.summary: Braun Corporation (Braun) is recalling certain 2023-2026 Chrysler Pacifica vehicles. The retractors may not lock, preventing the wheelchair from being properly secured.

items.title: Forest River, Inc.: Waste Holding Tank May Vent Sewer Gas into Cabin
items.summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026 Prime Time Crusader recreational trailers. The waste water holding tank ventilation pipe may end inside the trailer, allowing sewer gas to enter the cabin.

items.title: International Motors, LLC: Delayed Service Brake Release/FMVSS 121
items.summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2026-2027 HV vehicles. The service brake may take longer than expected to release. As such, these vehicles may fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 121, "Air Brake Systems."

items.title: Dometic Corporation: Vent Fan Lid May Detach in Transit
items.summary: Dometic Corporation (Dometic) is recalling certain Fan-Tastic Vent Fans with part numbers 9610007185, 9610007184, 9610007183, 9610007182, 9610007181, and 9610007180. The vent fan assembly may be missing a hinge pin, allowing the lid to detach.

items.title: Taizhou Qianxin Vehicle Co. Ltd: Brakes May Not Function Properly/FMVSS 122
items.summary: Taizhou Qianxin Vehicle Co. Ltd is recalling certain 2024 Fly Wing Snake 250 EFI motorcycles. The brake pads may fail to stop the motorcycle as intended in wet road conditions. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 122, “Motorcycle Brake Systems.”

items.title: Shyft Group: Unintended Brake Light Illumination/FMVSS 108
items.summary: Shyft Group (Shyft) is recalling certain 2025 Spartan RV Chassis K1, 2024-2026 RV Chassis K2, RV Chassis K3, and 2025-2027 RV Chassis K4 vehicles. The exterior brake lights may remain illuminated when the driver is not applying the brakes. items.title: Fontaine Trailer Company: Do Not Drive: Main Beams May Crack
items.summary: Fontaine Trailer Company (Fontaine Trailer) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Fusion flatbed trailers. The main beams may have been contaminated with hydrogen during the galvanization process, causing the beams to crack.

items.title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Fuel Tank May Leak After Crash
items.summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Taos vehicles. In the event of a rear-end crash, the fuel pressure sensor may dislodge or separate from the fuel tank. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 301, "Fuel System Integrity."

items.title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: Park Outside: Generator May Turn On Without Operator Action
items.summary: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2022-2027 Ekko motorhomes. The touchscreen display may register unintended or phantom inputs and turn on the generator without the operator's knowledge.

items.title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Improperly Welded Seat Brackets
items.summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2025 RAV 4 vehicles. The front seat brackets for the seat rails may be welded improperly.

items.title: Tesla, Inc.: Wheel Stud May Separate
items.summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Cybertruck vehicles equipped with 18-inch steel wheels. The brake rotor stud holes may crack and allow the stud to separate from the wheel hub.

items.title: Hyundai Motor America: Misassembled Air Bag Sensors
items.summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2025 Elantra N, 2026 Tucson, Tucson Hybrid, Tucson Plug-In Hybrid Electric (PHEV), and Elantra vehicles. The B-pillar impact sensors may have been misassembled, which can delay air bag deployment.

items.title: Hexagon Purus Systems USA LLC: Digital Display May Show Incorrect Air Brake Pressure/FMVSS 121
items.summary: Hexagon Purus Systems USA LLC (Hexagon Purus) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Tern RC8 vehicles. A software error may occur between the digital display cluster and the pressure sensors, causing the system to show the incorrect air brake pressure and falsely indicate a brake system failure. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS)

items.title: Mitsubishi Motors North America, Inc.: Liftgate Gas Springs May Rupture
items.summary: Mitsubishi Motors North America, Inc. (MMNA) is recalling certain 2018-2022 Outlander PHEV and 2014-2020 Outlander vehicles. The liftgate gas spring cylinders may corrode and lose pressure, which can result in a gas spring cylinder rupture or the liftgate falling unexpectedly.

items.title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Driver Seat Belt Anchor Improperly Installed/FMVSS 210
items.summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Thomas Built SAF-T-LINER HDX2 transit buses. The driver seat belt anchor may have been installed with inadequate hardware. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages."

items.title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Driver Seat Belt Anchor Improperly Installed/FMVSS 210
items.summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Thomas Built SAF-T-LINER HDX2 school buses. The driver seat belt anchor may have been installed with inadequate hardware. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages."

items.title: Q'Straint: Wheelchair Restraint Retractor May Not Lock
items.summary: Q'Straint is recalling certain QRT-3 wheelchair retractors. The retractors may not lock, preventing the wheelchair from being properly secured.

items.title: Forest River, Inc.: Contact with Fender May Damage Tire
items.summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026 East to West College Avenue and 2026-2027 Entrada recreational vehicles. The fender may contact and damage the rear tire.

items.title: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company: Tire Tread May Separate
items.summary: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company (Goodyear) is recalling certain Eagle F1 Supersport tires, sizes 305/30ZR21 and 255/35ZR20. The tire tread may separate.

items.title: Blue Bird Body Company: Improperly Tightened Windshield Wiper Blade Assemblies
items.summary: Blue Bird Bus Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2026-2027 All American school buses. The retention nuts between the wiper blades and the mounting arms may have been improperly tightened.

items.title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Improperly Installed Front End Radar
items.summary: Altec Industries, Inc. is recalling certain 2025-2026 Digger Derrick and 2025-2026 Aerial Device vehicles. The front end radar was improperly installed, which may result in improper operation of the Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) and Active Brake Assist (ABA).

items.title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Engine Failure May Cause Fire or Loss of Drive Power
items.summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain Mopar engines with part numbers 68364632CB and 68412483AF. Debris inside the engine may cause engine failure, which can result in a loss of drive power and/or an engine compartment fire.

items.title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Loss of Electronic Stability Control/FMVSS 126
items.summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2026 Ram 2500 Pickup trucks. The trucks may be equipped with steering column control modules that can cause a loss of electronic stability control. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 126, "Electronic Stability Control Systems."

items.title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Inoperative Emergency Stop Switch
items.summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2025-2026 AM Series Aerial Device vehicles. The emergency stop switch located at the turntable is inoperative when the upper controls interlock is active and allows the upper and lower controls to remain powered when the emergency stop is depressed.

items.title: Roush Performance Products, Inc.: Do Not Drive: Loss of Steering Control from Loose or Missing Fasteners
items.summary: Roush Performance Products, Inc. (Roush) is recalling certain 2026 Nissan Frontier Pro4X R vehicles. The cotter pins for the upper control arm ball joint and steering tie rod ends may not have been installed, and fasteners may not be properly tightened.

items.title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: Missing Side Reflectors/FMVSS 108
items.summary: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2027 Suncruiser and 2026-2027 Sunflyer motorhomes. The side reflectors may not have been installed. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

items.title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Brake Pedal May Detach from Brake Booster
items.summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2019-2023 Audi E-Tron Quattro, 2020-2023 Audi E-Tron Sportback, 2024 Q8 E-Tron, Q8 Sportback E-Tron, SQ8 E-Tron, and SQ8 Sportback E-Tron vehicles. The fastener that connects the brake pedal and the brake booster may have been improperly assembled during manufacturing, which can cause the brake pedal to detach from the brake booster.

items.title: Ford Motor Company: Block Heater May Overheat and Cause Fire
items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Maverick and 2026 Bronco Sport vehicles equipped with a 1.5L or 2.0L MPC engine and an engine block heater. The engine block heater may overheat when the vehicle is parked with the block heater plugged in.

items.title: Ford Motor Company: Sun Visor Wiring May Cause Fire
items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Ranger vehicles. The sun visor or headliner wiring harnesses may be improperly positioned or have excessive tape thickness, which can result in damaged wires.

items.title: Ford Motor Company: Unexpected Downshift Can Cause Loss of Control
items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2015-2017 F-150 vehicles. A loss of signal between the transmission range sensor and the powertrain control module can cause the transmission to unexpectedly downshift into second gear.

items.title: Ford Motor Company: Loss of Drive Power due to Transmission Misalignment
items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Bronco vehicles. The transmission to transfer case joint may be misaligned due to an incorrectly performed previous repair, which could lead to wear of the transmission output shaft splines and transfer case input splines.

items.title: Ford Motor Company: Missing Front Axle Hub Spindle Nut
items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025-2026 F-59 and F-53 vehicles. The front axle hub assembly may be missing the spindle nut and cotter pin.

items.title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: Loss of Rear Brakes
items.summary: Harley-Davidson Motor Company (Harley-Davidson) is recalling certain 2025-2026 FLHC, FXBB, FXLRS, and FXLRST Softail motorcycles. The rear brake line may contact the Body Control Module (BCM), resulting in a hole in the brake line, a brake fluid leak, and loss of the rear brakes.

items.title: Jayco, Inc.: Incorrect Seating Capacity on Label/FMVSS 110

The Occupant and Cargo Carrying Capacity (OCCC) and Tire Loading Information labels state an incorrect number of seat belt equipped seating positions, which can result in unbelted passengers. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 110

items.title: Kia America, Inc.: Fuel Leak at Pipe Connection
items.summary: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2022-2026 Carnival vehicles. Fuel may leak at the pipe connection between the fuel pipe and fuel rail.

items.title: Bentley Motors, Inc.: Incorrect Weight Capacity on Label/FMVSS 110
items.summary: Bentley Motors, Inc. (Bentley) is recalling certain 2026 Bentayga vehicles. The maximum vehicle capacity weight value on the tire placard label is incorrect.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

items.title: Hyundai Motor America: Fuel Leak at Pipe Connection
items.summary: Hyundai Motor America (Genesis) is recalling certain Genesis 2022-2026 GV70, 2023-2025 G90, 2021-2025 G80, and GV80 vehicles. Fuel may leak at the pipe connection between the fuel pipe and fuel rail.

items.title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Air Bag Inflator May Rupture or Detach from Steering Wheel

items.title: Isuzu Motors Limited: Improperly Secured Chassis and Cab Wire Harness
items.summary: Isuzu Motors Limited (Isuzu) is recalling certain 2025-2027 Chevrolet Low Cab Forward 5500XD, 4500XD, Isuzu NRR, NPR HD, NPR XD, 2025-2026 Chevrolet Low Cab Forward 4500HD, and Isuzu NRR EV vehicles. The chassis and/or cab wire harnesses may chafe against metal components, leading to harness failure.

items.title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Sunroof Malfunction/FMVSS 118
items.summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2026 Q3 vehicles. Incorrect software may allow remote sunroof closing from a distance that prevents the operator from clearly seeing the sunroof. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 118, "Power-Operated Window Systems."

items.title: Volvo Trucks North America: Turn Signal Failure/FMVSS 108
items.summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2025-2027 VNL (4) and 2026-2027 VNR (4) vehicles. The vehicle turn signals may not function properly. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

items.title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: Turn Signal Failure/FMVSS 108
items.summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2025-2027 Pioneer (4) and 2027 Anthem (4) trailers. The trailer turn signals may not function properly. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

items.title: Ricon Corporation: PTSB Gear Motor May Fail to Lock Seat In Place/FMVSS 207
items.summary: Ricon Corporation (Ricon) is recalling certain R1200 series 6-Way and 4-Way Power Transfer Seat Base (PTSB) motorized seat bases. The PTSB gear motor may fail to lock the seat in place when certain forces are applied. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 207, "Seating Systems."

items.title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Window Glass may Detach from Frame/FMVSS 217
items.summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2025 LFS and 2024 LFS Artic transit buses. Inadequate adhesion around the window frame may cause the glass to detach. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."

items.title: Ford Motor Company: Incorrectly Installed Piston Circlips
items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2026 Explorer and Mustang vehicles. The engine piston circlips may have been incorrectly installed during manufacturing, which can result in piston failure and engine damage, leading to a loss of drive power.

items.title: Ford Motor Company: Windshield Wipers May Fail
items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Lincoln Navigator, Expedition, and 2022-2023 F-250 SD, F-350 SD, F-450 SD, F-550 SD, and F-600 SD vehicles. The windshield wiper arms may break, causing the wipers to fail.

items.title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Insufficient Pedestrian Warning Sound/FMVSS 141
items.summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Corolla Cross Hybrid vehicles. The vehicles may fail to make sufficient pedestrian warning sounds when in reverse. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 141, "Minimum Sound Requirements for Hybrid and Electric Vehicles."

items.title: Ford Motor Company: Inoperative Defrosting and Defogging System
items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2026 Lincoln Aviator and Explorer vehicles. The heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC) system may fail, which can cause the defrosting and defogging system to become inoperative.

items.title: Ford Motor Company: Front Passenger Air Bag May Not Deploy/FMVSS 208
items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Bronco Sport and Maverick vehicles. The Occupant Classification Sensor (OCS) unit may fail to correctly detect the presence of an adult or child in the front passenger seat.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

items.title: Terex South Dakota, Inc.: Cracked Weld May Cause Pole Guide Arm to Fall
items.summary: Terex South Dakota, Inc. (Terex) is recalling certain pole position guide arm assembly pins with part number 450543. An insufficient weld on the plate weldment may crack, causing the retaining pin to separate.

items.title: Aston Martin The Americas: Rear Lower Suspension Arm Failure
items.summary: Aston Martin The Americas (Aston Martin) is recalling certain 2026 DBX S, 2023-2026 DBX707, and 2021-2024 DBX vehicles. The pin for the torque reaction link may slide out of the rear lower suspension arm, causing the rear lower suspension arm casting to crack or shear.

items.title: Yamaha Motor Corporation, USA: Do Not Ride: Speedometer Failure
items.summary: Yamaha Motor Corporation, USA (Yamaha) is recalling certain 2026 TW200 motorcycles. The speedometer may become inoperative or display an inaccurate speed.

items.title: Luxfer Canada Ltd.: Gas Cylinder Adapter O-Ring May Leak
items.summary: Luxfer Canada Ltd. (Luxfer) is recalling certain Unified Fine Pitch thread adapters, model EP-O-350-8-U5 with part number K0079. The O-ring recess in the gas cylinder adapter may be incompatible with certain valve types.

items.title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Air Bag May Not Deploy as Intended
items.summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2026 GLE 350 4MATIC, GLE 450 4MATIC, GLE 350, GLE 580 4MATIC, GLS 580 4MATIC, GLE 450 E 4MATIC, AMG GLE53 4MATIC, AMG GLS63 4MATIC, AMG GLE63 S 4MATIC, GLS 450 4MATIC, and GLS 600 4MATIC vehicles. The passenger air bag fabric may have been manufactured incorrectly, which can cause the air bag not to deploy as intended.

items.title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Loose Wheel Bolts
items.summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2025 G580 vehicles. The incorrect wheel bolts may have been installed during vehicle manufacturing.

items.title: KTM North America, Inc.: Throttle Failure
items.summary: KTM North America, Inc. is recalling certain 2022-2023 390 Duke and 2022-2024 RC 390 motorcycles. Water may enter the throttle (e-throttle) control unit and cause it to fail, resulting in loss of drive power while riding.

items.title: Triumph Motorcycles America, Ltd.: Insufficient Illumination from Headlight Low Beam/FMVSS 108
items.summary: Triumph Motorcycles America, Ltd. is recalling certain 2026 Trident 800 motorcycles. During pre-delivery inspection (PDI), the diagnostic tool may have loaded an incorrect headlight low beam configuration, causing the low beams to illuminate improperly. items.title: Lippert: Incorrect Seal Used on Axle During Assembly
items.summary: Lippert is recalling certain 8K axles. Please see the 573 Safety Recall Report for a full list of affected part numbers. The axle hubs were incorrectly assembled with a grease seal rather than an oil seal, causing oil to leak.

items.title: General Motors, LLC: Roof Rail Air Bag Inflator Endcap May Detach
items.summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2018 Chevrolet Silverado 1500, GMC Sierra 1500, 2019 Chevrolet Silverado 2500, Silverado 3500, GMC Sierra 2500, and Sierra 3500 Crew Cab vehicles.  The left or right-side roof rail air bag (RRAB) inflator end cap may detach from the inflator or the inflator sidewall may rupture.

items.title: Ford Motor Company: Loss of Rearview Camera Image and ADAS Features
items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022-2025 Lincoln Navigator, 2024-2025 Lincoln Nautilus, 2025 Lincoln Aviator and Explorer vehicles. items.title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Insufficiently Welded Seat Belt Anchorage Bracket

items.title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111
items.summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2022-2025 Lexus NX350, NX250, 2023-2026 RX350, and 2024-2026 TX350 vehicles. The rearview camera image may not display when the vehicle is placed in reverse. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."

items.title: Keystone RV Company: Improperly Secured Wiring May Be Damaged
items.summary: Keystone RV Company (Keystone) is recalling certain 2026 Montana fifth wheel recreational trailers. The 12-volt and 120-volt wiring may be improperly secured. The wires may be pinched and damaged when the bedroom slide-out moves.

items.title: Hyundai Motor America: Power Rear Seats May Trap a Person
items.summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2026 Palisade and 2026 Palisade Hybrid vehicles equipped with a Limited or Calligraphy trim package. The second and third row power seats may fail to detect a person. The seat may continue to move after contacting a person during powered seat functions, such as one-touch tilt-and-slide or automatic power fold-and-stow.

items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2026 Explorer and Lincoln Aviator vehicles. The seat belt anchor bolts at the second-row outer seating positions may be improperly secured.

items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2022 F-Super Duty F250, F350, F450, F550, 2021-2022 F600, and 2022 F750 vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under recall number 24V957. Biodiesel deposits may form on the pump drivetrain roller components, which could lead to failure of the high pressure fuel pump.

items.title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Second-Row Seat Backs May Fail to Lock

items.title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Lane Departure Warning Deactivated

items.title: Newmar Corporation: Heating System Incorrectly Wired

items.title: Subaru of America, Inc.: Park Outside - Fuel Cap May Leak Fuel
items.summary: Subaru of America, Inc. is recalling certain 2026 Crosstrek hybrid, and 2025 Forester hybrid vehicles. items.title: Kia America, Inc.: Front Seat Back Frames May Fail
items.summary: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2025 Telluride vehicles, equipped with power front seat(s). Due to a manufacturing error, the driver and passenger seat back frame assemblies may fail to properly restrain occupants in a crash.

items.title: Ford Motor Company: Trailer Lighting and Brakes May Not Function/FMVSS 108

items.title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: High Voltage Battery Fire Risk
items.summary: Volvo Car USA, LLC (Volvo Car) is recalling certain 2025 EX30 vehicles. The high voltage battery may experience a short circuit and overheat.

items.title: Orange EV: Missing Door Handle Lock/FMVSS 206
items.summary: Orange EV (OEV) is recalling certain 2018-2023 T-Series Pure Electric and 2024-2026 e-TRIEVER terminal trucks. The driver's side door handles may be missing a lock. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 206, "Door Locks and Door Retention Components."

items.title: Rossmonster Vans LLC: Brake Lines May Become Damaged and Leak
items.summary: Rossmonster Vans LLC (Rossmonster) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Baja Ex and Baja LX motorhomes, equipped with Carli extended stainless steel front brake lines. The brake lines may have been incorrectly routed, allowing the brake line to contact the front tire. Contact with the tire may damage the brake lines and cause a leak.

items.title: Ford Motor Company: Rear Suspension Toe Link Fracture
items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2017-2019 Explorer vehicles. The rear suspension toe links may fracture.

items.title: Daimler Vans USA, LLC: Insufficient Pedestrian Warning Sound/FMVSS 141
items.summary: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2025 Mercedes-Benz eSprinter vehicles. The vehicles fail to make sufficient pedestrian warning sounds when in reverse. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 141, "Minimum Sound Requirements for Hybrid and Electric Vehicles."

items.title: Braun Industries, Inc.: Insufficient Floor Strength/FMVSS 207, 210
items.summary: Braun Industries, Inc. (Braun Ambulances) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Demers FXP174 ambulances. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 207, "Seating Systems" and 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages."

items.title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Panoramic Sunroof Side Trim May Detach
items.summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2023-2026 Range Rover Sport and Range Rover vehicles. The panoramic sunroof side finisher trim may not be properly secured and can detach.

items.title: BMW of North America, LLC: A/C Wiring Harness May Short-Circuit
items.summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2025 M5 Sportswagon, 2025-2026 M5, 2024-2025 750e xDrive, 2025-2026 550e xDrive, 2023-2025 I7, 2023-2025 7 Series, 2024-2026 i5, and 5 Series vehicles. The electrical wiring harness for the air conditioning system may become damaged during replacement of the cabin air filter.

items.title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Exterior Driver Side Mirror May Detach
items.summary: Prevost Car (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2026 H3-45 and H3-45 VIP vehicles equipped with aftermarket exterior driver side mirrors. The mirror exhibits excessive play and may detach.

items.title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Exterior Driver Side Mirror May Detach
items.summary: Prevost Car (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain exterior driver side mirrors with part number 990648. The mirror exhibits excessive play and may detach.

items.title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Loss of Drive Power from Transmission Damage
items.summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Lexus LX600 vehicles. In the event of transmission solenoid failure, the communication may fail between the transmission electronic control unit (ECU) and the engine ECU, resulting in transmission damage.

items.title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: Rear Roof Cap May Detach
items.summary: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2020-2023 View and Navion recreational vehicles. The rear roof cap aerofence trim may become loose and detach during transit.

items.title: Shyft Group: Gearbox May Bind and Cause Loss of Steering
items.summary: Shyft Group (Shyft) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Blue Arc BA4L-800 vehicles. The mounting fasteners may loosen or detach, causing the steering gearbox to bind.

items.title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Improperly Installed Passenger Seat Anchors
items.summary: Prevost Car (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2025-2026 X3-45 commuter buses. The passenger seat anchors may have been improperly installed.

items.title: Ford Motor Company: High Voltage Battery May Short Circuit
items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022-2026 Ford Escape and 2023-2026 Lincoln Corsair plug-in hybrid vehicles. A manufacturing defect in one or more of the high voltage battery cells may result in an internal short circuit and battery failure.

items.title: Ford Motor Company: Do Not Drive - Loss of Brake Function/FMVSS 105
items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Transit vehicles. The brake pedal may disconnect from the brake booster pushrod, causing a loss of brake function. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 105, "Hydraulic and Electric Brake Systems."

items.title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Heater Hose May Leak Hot Heating Coolant Inside Passenger Compartment
items.summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain Thomas Built Buses 2023-2025 Saf-T-Liner EFX and 2023-2026 Saf-T-Liner HDX vehicles. The heater hose clamps may not have been tightened properly, causing the hose to disconnect and leak heating coolant inside the passenger compartment.

items.title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Heater Hose May Leak Hot Heating Coolant Inside Passenger Compartment

items.title: General Motors, LLC: Rear Wheel Lock Up from Transmission Control Valve Failure
items.summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2022 Chevrolet Tahoe, Chevrolet Suburban, GMC Yukon, GMC Yukon XL, Cadillac Escalade, and Cadillac Escalade ESV vehicles equipped with 10 Speed Transmission with ETRS (Electronic Transmission Range Select). items.title: International Motors, LLC: Brakes May Fail to Activate with Adaptive Cruise Control
items.summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2026-2027 MV vehicles. The ECU software may fail to engage the brakes with adaptive cruise control (ACC) or hill hold assist.

items.title: General Motors, LLC: Rear Wheel Lock Up from Transmission Control Valve Failure
items.summary: General Motors, LLC is recalling certain 2020 Chevrolet Silverado 2500, 3500, GMC Sierra 2500, 3500, and 2020-2022 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 and GMC Sierra 1500 vehicles that may have been repaired incorrectly under recall 24V797. The transmission control valve may fail and cause the rear wheels to lock up.

items.title: General Motors, LLC: Rearview Camera May Fail
items.summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2024 Lyriq vehicles. The rearview camera screen may turn gray with no camera image.

items.title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Gears in the Electronic Throttle Body May Break
items.summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Rogue vehicles equipped with 3-cylinder 1.5L variable compression turbo (VC-Turbo) engines. The gears in the electronic throttle body assembly may break.

items.title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Engine Failure
items.summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Rogue vehicles equipped with 3-cylinder 1.5L variable compression turbo (VC-Turbo) engines. Increased temperatures can break down the engine oil, which may cause the engine bearings to seize and become damaged, leading to engine failure.

items.title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Improper Battery Connection May Cause Fire
items.summary: Daimler Trucks North America (DTNA) is recalling certain 2020-2027 Western Star 49X and 2021-2027 Western Star 47X vehicles. A stud connecting the battery to the starter at the frame rail may have been incorrectly installed or may corrode, which can cause a short circuit.

items.title: General Rubber (Thailand) Co., Ltd: Tires May Crack and Separate/FMVSS 139
items.summary: General Rubber (Thailand) Co., Ltd (General Rubber) is recalling certain Xcellent Roadbreaker A/T tires, size LT305/65R17 with a tire identification number that ends in “4324.” The tire may crack and the inner liner may separate, which can result in tire failure. items.title: Triumph Motorcycles America, Ltd.: Alternator Wiring May Short and Overheat
items.summary: Triumph Motorcycles America, Ltd. is recalling certain 2022-2024 Bonneville T100, Bonneville T120, Bonneville T120 Black, 2024 Bonneville T120 DGR, 2022 Street Twin, Street Scrambler, Street Twin Goldline, Street Scrambler Sandstor, 2023-2024 Speed Twin 900, and Scrambler 900 motorcycles. The wiring between the alternator and main harness connector may short circuit and overheat.

items.title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Mounting Rails May Crack and Cause Seat to Fall
items.summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2013-2019 LFS and 2019-2020 LFS Artic transit buses equipped with Double Transversal seats. The passenger seat mounting rails may crack, causing the seat to detach and fall to the floor.

items.title: PT. Elangperdana Tyre Industry: Tire Sidewall May Separate/FMVSS 139
items.summary: PT. Elangperdana Tyre Industry (EP Tyre) is recalling certain Vizzoni Dreamliner A/T tires, size LT265/75R16. The sidewall may separate. As such, these tires fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 139, "New Pneumatic Radial Tires for Light Vehicles."

items.title: Vee Tyre and Rubber Co., Ltd.: Tire May Separate and Fail/FMVSS 139
items.summary: Vee Tyre and Rubber Co., Ltd. (Vee Tyre) is recalling certain Taiga AT tires, size LT235/85R16 AT. The lower sidewall and inner liner may crack and separate. As such, these tires fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 139, "New Pneumatic Radial Tires for Light Vehicles."

items.title: Volvo Trucks North America: Rollaway Risk from Inadequate Parking Brake Force
items.summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2024-2027 VNL (4) vehicles that do not include auxiliary parking brakes.  If the vehicle is in weight bias mode there may not be enough weight on the parking brake axle, which could result in inadequate parking brake force.

items.title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: Upper Triple Clamp May Fracture
items.summary: Harley-Davidson Motor Company (Harley) is recalling certain 2021-2026 RH1250S (Sportster S) motorcycles. The upper triple clamp may fracture.

items.title: Oshkosh Corporation: Brake Pedal Mounting Pin and Retaining Clip Not Installed
items.summary: Oshkosh Corporation (Oshkosh Defense) is recalling certain 2025-2026 NGDV vehicles. The mounting pin and retaining clip that retain the brake actuator rod to the brake pedal may not have been installed.

items.title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Park Outside - High Voltage Battery May Catch Fire
items.summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2023-2024 EQB 250+, 2022-2024 EQB 300 4MATIC, and EQB 350 4MATIC vehicles. The high voltage battery may fail internally and lead to a vehicle fire while parked or driving.

items.title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: Doors May Open Unexpectedly/FMVSS 206
items.summary: Volvo Car USA, LLC (Volvo Car) is recalling certain 2017 S60L vehicles. A component within the door latch may break, preventing the door from latching properly. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 206, "Door Locks and Door Retention Components."

items.title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Chassis Engine May Start Unexpectedly
items.summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Digger Derrick and 2021-2025 AM Series Aerial Device vehicles. The chassis engine may start unintentionally due to a missing diode in the Altec power distribution module.

items.title: Toyo Tire Holdings of Americas, Inc.: Tire Tread May Separate
items.summary: Toyo Tire Holdings of Americas, Inc. (Toyo) is recalling certain Open Country A/T III tires, sizes 265/70R18 116T and 265/60R20 115T. The tread may separate from the tire.

items.title: Daimler Vans USA, LLC: Air Bags May Not Deploy
items.summary: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2020 and 2022-2023 Mercedes-Benz Metris right-hand-drive vehicles. Water may accumulate on the air bag control unit, which can cause the air bags not to deploy as intended.

items.title: Hyundai Motor America: Loss of Steering Control from Cracked Steering Knuckle Assembly
items.summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2026 Kona vehicles. Due to a manufacturing error, the front steering knuckles may crack and break, which can result in a loss of vehicle steering control.

items.title: Hyundai Motor America: High Voltage Battery May Catch Fire
items.summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2025-2026 IONIQ 5 and 2026 IONIQ 9 vehicles. The high voltage battery system may contain an improperly tightened bus bar, which can cause a short-circuit.

items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2026 E-Transit vehicles. Bolts inside the high-voltage battery pack may be missing washers, which can cause high electrical resistance or electrical arcing.

items.title: Ford Motor Company: Engine Crossmember Improperly Secured
items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Transit vehicles. The engine crossmember may not be secured properly, which can cause the engine to shift and possibly result in a loss of drive power or brake failure.

items.title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Inoperative Trailer Lighting and Trailer Brake Failure
items.summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Jeep Wagoneer S, 2025-2026 Ram 1500 Pickup, Ram 2500 Pickup, Ram 3500 Pickup, Ram 3500 Cab Chassis, Ram 4500 Cab Chassis, Ram 5500 Cab Chassis, and 2026 Jeep Cherokee vehicles. Due to an improperly designed trailer tow module, the trailer lights may fail to illuminate and the trailer brakes may fail.

items.title: Pierce Manufacturing: Steering Linkage Arm May Detach
items.summary: Pierce Manufacturing (Pierce) is recalling certain 2025 Velocity, Saber, Impel, Enforcer, and Arrow XT vehicles. The steering linkage arm bolt may come loose, resulting in the steering linkage arm detaching from the steering motor.

items.title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Inoperative Trailer Lighting and Trailer Brake Failure
items.summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain Mopar tow trailer modules. Please refer to FCA US, LLC's recall report for specific model numbers. Due to an improperly designed trailer tow module, the trailer lights may fail to illuminate and the trailer brakes may fail.

items.title: Grand Design RV, LLC: Driver and Passenger Seat Base Improperly Tightened/FMVSS 207
items.summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Lineage motorhomes. The seat base on the driver and front passenger seat may have been improperly tightened, causing the base to become loose.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 207, “Seating Systems.”

items.title: Grand Design RV, LLC: Water Tank Heating Pad May Fail
items.summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2026 Solitude recreational vehicles equipped with a ThermaHeat Tank Pad. The water tank heating pad may experience high resistance and fail.

items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 F-59 and F-53 vehicles. The exterior brake lights may illuminate unexpectedly or fail to illuminate when the brake pedal is activated, due to an incorrectly installed switch.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipme

items.title: Ford Motor Company: Inadequate Windshield Bonding/FMVSS 212
items.summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2026 Explorer vehicles. During manufacturing, the windshield may not have been properly bonded to the vehicle, allowing it to detach in a crash.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 212, "Windshield Mounting."

items.title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Improperly Welded Door Strikers/FMVSS 206
items.summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2025 Altima, Sentra, 2025-2026 Frontier, and 2026 Kicks vehicles. The door strikers may have been improperly welded and break, allowing the door to open while moving. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 206, "Door Locks and Door Retention Components."

items.title: Evenflo Company, Inc.: Child Seat Missing Tether Strap
items.summary: Evenflo Company, Inc. (Evenflo) is recalling certain Titan 65 child seats with model numbers CS200312198, CS200311198, 3712198, and 3711198. The child seats may have been manufactured without a tether strap.

items.title: PACCAR Incorporated: Steering Cross-Shaft May Fail
items.summary: PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2026 Kenworth L770 and 2024-2026 Peterbilt 520 vehicles. The right-hand stand-up (RHSU) configuration on the steering cross-shaft may become stressed and fail.

items.title: VLRV, LLC (Vanleigh RV): Ramp Door May Break During Use
items.summary: VLRV, LLC (Vanleigh RV) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Ambition trailers. The ramp door may break away from the door frame while loading or unloading vehicles.

items.title: Forest River, Inc.: Ramp Door May Break During Use
items.summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2023-2026 Forest River Work and Play, 2024-2026 East to West Takoda, Coachmen Chaparral, 2025-2026 Shasta Phoenix, 2023-2025 Forest River Riverstone, 2022-2026 Coachmen Adrenaline, and 2025 Forest River Cedar Creek fifth wheel travel trailers. The ramp door may break away from the door frame while loading or unloading vehicles.

items.title: Lucid USA, Inc.: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111
items.summary: Lucid USA, Inc. (Lucid) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Gravity vehicles operating a software version prior to 3.3.20. The rearview camera image may not display when the vehicle is placed in reverse. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

items.title: Hyundai Motor America: Instrument Panel Display Failure/FMVSS 101
items.summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain Genesis 2025-2026 G80, GV80, 2026 G80 "Electrified," GV60, GV70 "Electrified" and GV70 vehicles. Due to a software error, the instrument panel display may fail. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 101, "Controls and Displays."

items.title: Lucid USA, Inc.: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111
items.summary: Lucid USA, Inc. (Lucid) is recalling certain 2022-2026 Air vehicles equipped with an AD02 package and operating a software version from 2.8.0 through 2.8.16. The rearview camera image may not display when the vehicle is placed in reverse. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

items.title: Lippert: Illegible DOT Marking on Window/FMVSS 205
items.summary: Lippert is recalling certain bus windows. Please see the recall report for the full list of affected part numbers. The windows may have illegible DOT markings. As such these windows fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 205, "Glazing Materials."

items.title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: Water Tank Heating Pad May Fail
items.summary: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Spirit, Minnie Winnie, Travato, View, Navion, and 2026-2027 Sunflyer, 2021-2026 Commercial vehicle, and 2023-2026 425 Commercial shell motorhomes equipped with a ThermaHeat Tank Pad. The water tank heating pad may experience high resistance and fail.

items.title: Newmar Corporation: Water Tank Heating Pad May Fail
items.summary: Newmar Corporation (Newmar) is recalling certain 2026 Freedom Aire motorhomes equipped with a ThermaHeat Tank Pad. The water tank heating pad may experience high resistance and fail.

items.title: Forest River Bus, LLC: Modified Floor Plan May Exceed GAWR/FMVSS 120
items.summary: Forest River bus, LLC (Forest River Bus) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Trans Tech school buses. The modified seating floor plan may exceed the the rear Gross Axle Weight Rating (GAWR). As such these vehicles fail to comply with the Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 120, "Wheels and Rims - Other Than Passenger Cars."

items.title: Forest River, Inc.: Solar Panel Wiring Missing Over-Current Protection
items.summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026 Freelander motorhomes. The solar panel wire may have been incorrectly connected to a breaker without over-current protection.

items.summary: Evenflo Company, Inc. (Evenflo) is recalling certain All4One child seats. Please refer to Evenflo's recall report for specific model numbers. In rear-facing mode, the adjustable recline mechanism may shift out of proper position. As such, these child seats fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 213, "Child Restraint Systems."

items.title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Incorrect Spare Tire Installed/FMVSS 110
items.summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2026 Rogue vehicles. The incorrect-size spare tire may have been installed, which does not match the tire size and inflation pressure information on the tire placard. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

items.title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Damaged Wire Harness/FMVSS 108
items.summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2024-2025 CBR650R motorcycles. Engine vibration may cause the turn signal switch wire harness to become damaged, which can cause an electrical short circuit and blown fuse. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

items.title: Spartan Fire, LLC: Ladder Lock Handle May Detach Allowing Ladder to Fall Into Road
items.summary: Spartan Fire, LLC (Spartan) is recalling certain 2021-2023, 2025 Spartan Fire Legend, 2007, 2015-2026 Star Series, and 2019-2020 UST Body emergency vehicles.  A handle may detach from the ladder lock assembly, allowing the ground ladders to fall off.

items.title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Hydraulic System May Have Missing Check Valve
items.summary: Altec Industries, Inc.(Altec) is recalling certain 2022-2023 AA55, 2023 AM55, AN46, and AN55 vehicles. A check valve that retains oil in the boom hoses may not have been installed, allowing a vacuum to form and reducing the upper boom’s insulation.

items.title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111
items.summary: Volvo Car USA, LLC (Volvo Car) is recalling certain 2021-2025 XC40, 2022 V90, 2022-2024 C40BEV, 2022-2025 S90, V90CC, XC60, 2023-2025 S60, V60, V60CC, XC90, and 2025 EC40, and EX40 vehicles. The rearview camera image may not display when the vehicle is placed in reverse. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibili

items.title: KTM North America, Inc.: Side Stand Spring May Break
items.summary: KTM North America, Inc. (KTM) is recalling certain 2025 390 Adventure R, 390 SMC R, 390 Adventure X, and 390 Enduro R motorcycles. Engine vibrations may cause the side stand spring to break and the side stand to fall to the ground.

items.title: BMW of North America, LLC: Improperly Secured Positive Battery Cable
items.summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling one 2025 I4 EDRIVE40 vehicle. The connection between the positive battery cable and the rear power distributor may become loose.

items.title: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc.: Wire May Overheat Between Battery and Inverter
items.summary: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc. (Tiffin) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Open Trail motorhomes equipped with an optional diesel or propane generator. The wiring harness may contain incorrectly sized wires.

items.title: Terminal Investment Corporation: Loss of Steering Control from Track Rod Detachment
items.summary: Terminal Investment Corporation (TICO) is recalling certain 2018-2026 Pro Spotter Tandem tractors. The track rod mounting bracket for the forward rear axle, of the tandem axles set may crack and break, which can result in track rod detachment.

items.title: Couture Co Ltd: E-Bike Carrier Latch May Fail
items.summary: Couture Co Ltd (Couture Co) is recalling certain Hyperax Volt RV Lite part number B0B4NCZN87, 2024 Volt 2 LHB part number B0CNSYMC19, 2024 Volt 2 part number B0C4T56L8X, and 2023 Volt RV part number B0B48WK529 e-bike carriers. The e-bike carrier latch mechanism may experience excessive wear, disengaging while in transit.

items.title: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini): Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111
items.summary: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini) is recalling certain 2019-2024 Urus vehicles. A software error may deactivate the rearview camera image, resulting in the image not displaying. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."
